question: Alicia had two containers. The first was \(\dfrac{5}{6}\) full of water and the second was empty. She poured all the water from the first container into the second container, at which point the second container was \(\dfrac{3}{4}\) full of water. What is the ratio of the volume of the first container to the volume of the second container?
solution:
The amount of water stays the same when it is poured. Let \(x\) and \(y\) be the capacities of the first and second containers. Then
\[
\frac56x=\frac34y.
\]
Therefore the requested ratio is
\[
\frac{x}{y}=\frac{3/4}{5/6}
=\frac34\cdot\frac65
=\frac{18}{20}
=\boxed{\frac9{10}},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
